$comment: Editorial seed 2026ai (CONT-44): five es/en trivia pairs on rock and pop legends — Queen, Michael Jackson, Nirvana, Metallica and ABBA. Every answer is a stable, checkable fact. Applied by scripts/seed/emit-editorial-seed.mjs.

quizzes.title: Queen Trivia: The Band That Filled Stadiums
quizzes.description: Eight questions on Freddie Mercury and Queen: the classic albums, the anthems, Live Aid and the story of the band that filled stadiums.

questions.question: In which year was Queen formed in London?
questions.explanation: Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor and John Deacon came together in London in 1970.

questions.question: Which 1975 album includes 'Bohemian Rhapsody'?
questions.explanation: A Night at the Opera (1975) carried 'Bohemian Rhapsody' to the top of the UK charts.

questions.question: Who wrote 'Bohemian Rhapsody'?
questions.explanation: Mercury wrote the six-minute suite; the band recorded it across several studios.

questions.question: 'We Will Rock You' and 'We Are the Champions' appear on which 1977 album?
questions.explanation: News of the World (1977) opens with the two stadium anthems back to back.

questions.question: Queen's celebrated 1985 performance took place at which charity concert?
questions.explanation: On 13 July 1985, Queen played at Wembley a set often ranked among the greatest live performances in rock.

questions.question: Which 1980 song, written by bassist John Deacon, spent three weeks at number one in the US?
questions.explanation: John Deacon wrote 'Another One Bites the Dust' for The Game; it topped the Billboard Hot 100 for three weeks.

questions.question: With which artist did Queen record 'Under Pressure' in 1981?
questions.explanation: The song grew out of a joint studio session in Switzerland; its bass line is one of the most recognisable in rock.

questions.question: Which Queen member built his 'Red Special' guitar with his father?
questions.explanation: Brian May and his father Harold built the Red Special out of a fireplace mantel; May still plays it today.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Queen: la banda que llenó estadios
quizzes.description: Ocho preguntas sobre Freddie Mercury y Queen: los discos clásicos, los himnos, Live Aid y la historia de la banda que llenó estadios.

questions.question: ¿En qué año se formó Queen en Londres?
questions.explanation: Freddie Mercury, Brian May, Roger Taylor y John Deacon se unieron en Londres en 1970.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1975 incluye "Bohemian Rhapsody"?
questions.explanation: A Night at the Opera (1975) llevó "Bohemian Rhapsody" a la cima de las listas del Reino Unido.

questions.question: ¿Quién escribió "Bohemian Rhapsody"?
questions.explanation: Mercury escribió la suite de seis minutos; la banda la grabó repartida en varios estudios.

questions.question: "We Will Rock You" y "We Are the Champions" aparecen en qué disco de 1977?
questions.explanation: News of the World (1977) abre con los dos himnos de estadio uno tras otro.

questions.question: La celebrada actuación de Queen de 1985 fue en qué concierto benéfico?
questions.explanation: El 13 de julio de 1985, Queen tocó en Wembley una actuación considerada de las mejores en vivo de la historia del rock.

questions.question: ¿Qué canción de 1980, escrita por el bajista John Deacon, pasó tres semanas en el número uno de Estados Unidos?
questions.explanation: John Deacon escribió "Another One Bites the Dust" para The Game; encabezó el Billboard Hot 100 durante tres semanas.

questions.question: ¿Con qué artista grabó Queen "Under Pressure" en 1981?
questions.explanation: La canción nació de una sesión conjunta en Suiza; su línea de bajo es una de las más reconocibles del rock.

questions.question: ¿Qué miembro de Queen construyó con su padre la guitarra "Red Special"?
questions.explanation: Brian May y su padre Harold construyeron la Red Special con madera de una chimenea; May la toca hasta hoy.

quizzes.title: Michael Jackson Trivia: The King of Pop
quizzes.description: Eight questions on Michael Jackson: the Jackson 5 years, the Quincy Jones albums, Thriller and the moves that defined pop.

questions.question: Which 1982 album is the best-selling studio album in history?
questions.explanation: Thriller (1982) won a record eight Grammy Awards in 1984.

questions.question: With which family group did Michael Jackson first find fame?
questions.explanation: Michael was the lead singer of the Jackson 5, the group he formed with his brothers in Gary, Indiana.

questions.question: Which 1979 album was Jackson's adult breakthrough, with 'Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough'?
questions.explanation: Off the Wall (1979) was the first Jackson album produced by Quincy Jones.

questions.question: On which 1983 TV special did Jackson first perform the moonwalk?
questions.explanation: During 'Billie Jean' at Motown 25, Jackson unveiled the moonwalk in March 1983.

questions.question: Which producer co-created Off the Wall, Thriller and Bad with Jackson?
questions.explanation: Quincy Jones produced the three albums that turned Jackson into the biggest pop star in the world.

questions.question: Which 1987 album includes 'Bad', 'Smooth Criminal' and 'Man in the Mirror'?
questions.explanation: Bad produced five number-one singles on the Billboard Hot 100.

questions.question: In which city was Michael Jackson born in 1958?
questions.explanation: Gary, Indiana was the home of the Jackson family.

questions.question: Which 1991 album includes 'Black or White' and 'Remember the Time'?
questions.explanation: Dangerous debuted at number one on the Billboard 200.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Michael Jackson: el Rey del Pop
quizzes.description: Ocho preguntas sobre Michael Jackson: los Jackson 5, los discos con Quincy Jones, Thriller y los pasos que definieron el pop.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1982 es el álbum más vendido de la historia?
questions.explanation: Thriller (1982) ganó un récord de ocho premios Grammy en 1984.

questions.question: ¿Con qué grupo familiar alcanzó la fama Michael Jackson?
questions.explanation: Michael fue la voz principal de The Jackson 5, el grupo que formó con sus hermanos en Gary, Indiana.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1979 marcó su despegue adulto con "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough"?
questions.explanation: Off the Wall (1979) fue el primer disco de Jackson producido por Quincy Jones.

questions.question: ¿En qué especial de televisión de 1983 presentó Jackson el moonwalk?
questions.explanation: Durante "Billie Jean" en Motown 25, Jackson estrenó el moonwalk en marzo de 1983.

questions.question: ¿Qué productor creó con Jackson Off the Wall, Thriller y Bad?
questions.explanation: Quincy Jones produjo los tres discos que convirtieron a Jackson en la mayor estrella del pop.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1987 incluye "Bad", "Smooth Criminal" y "Man in the Mirror"?
questions.explanation: Bad produjo cinco sencillos número uno en el Billboard Hot 100.

questions.question: ¿En qué ciudad nació Michael Jackson en 1958?
questions.explanation: Gary, Indiana, fue el hogar de la familia Jackson.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1991 incluye "Black or White" y "Remember the Time"?
questions.explanation: Dangerous debutó en el número uno del Billboard 200.

quizzes.title: Nirvana Trivia: The Band That Led Grunge
quizzes.description: Eight questions on Nirvana: Kurt Cobain, Nevermind, In Utero and the Seattle scene that changed rock in the nineties.

questions.question: Which 1991 album made Nirvana world-famous with 'Smells Like Teen Spirit'?
questions.explanation: Nevermind knocked Michael Jackson's Dangerous from the top of the Billboard 200 in early 1992.

questions.question: Who was Nirvana's lead singer and guitarist?
questions.explanation: Kurt Cobain wrote and sang nearly all of Nirvana's songs.

questions.question: In which year was Nirvana formed in Aberdeen, Washington?
questions.explanation: Kurt Cobain and Krist Novoselic founded the band in Aberdeen in 1987.

questions.question: Which drummer joined Nirvana in 1990 and later founded Foo Fighters?
questions.explanation: Dave Grohl joined just before the recording of Nevermind; after Nirvana he created Foo Fighters.

questions.question: What is the title of Nirvana's 1989 debut album?
questions.explanation: Bleach (1989) was released by the independent label Sub Pop.

questions.question: Which was Nirvana's third and final studio album, featuring 'Heart-Shaped Box' and 'All Apologies'?
questions.explanation: In Utero (1993) was the last studio album released during Kurt Cobain's lifetime.

questions.question: Which producer, famous for his raw sound, recorded In Utero?
questions.explanation: Butch Vig produced Nevermind; Steve Albini recorded In Utero in February 1993.

questions.question: Nirvana's 1994 live album was recorded for which acoustic MTV series?
questions.explanation: Recorded in November 1993, MTV Unplugged in New York won a Grammy for best alternative music album in 1996.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Nirvana: la banda que lideró el grunge
quizzes.description: Ocho preguntas sobre Nirvana: Kurt Cobain, Nevermind, In Utero y la escena de Seattle que cambió el rock de los noventa.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1991 hizo mundialmente famoso a Nirvana con "Smells Like Teen Spirit"?
questions.explanation: Nevermind desplazó a Dangerous de Michael Jackson del número uno del Billboard 200 a comienzos de 1992.

questions.question: ¿Quién era el cantante y guitarrista de Nirvana?
questions.explanation: Kurt Cobain escribió y cantó casi todas las canciones de Nirvana.

questions.question: ¿En qué año se formó Nirvana en Aberdeen, Washington?
questions.explanation: Kurt Cobain y Krist Novoselic fundaron la banda en Aberdeen en 1987.

questions.question: ¿Qué baterista se unió a Nirvana en 1990 y luego fundó Foo Fighters?
questions.explanation: Dave Grohl se unió justo antes de la grabación de Nevermind; tras Nirvana creó Foo Fighters.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se titula el disco debut de Nirvana, de 1989?
questions.explanation: Bleach (1989) salió por el sello independiente Sub Pop.

questions.question: ¿Cuál fue el tercer y último disco de estudio de Nirvana, con "Heart-Shaped Box" y "All Apologies"?
questions.explanation: In Utero (1993) fue el último disco de estudio publicado en vida de Kurt Cobain.

questions.question: ¿Qué productor, famoso por su sonido crudo, grabó In Utero?
questions.explanation: Butch Vig produjo Nevermind; Steve Albini grabó In Utero en febrero de 1993.

questions.question: El disco en vivo de Nirvana de 1994 se grabó para qué serie acústica de MTV?
questions.explanation: Grabado en noviembre de 1993, MTV Unplugged in New York ganó el Grammy al mejor álbum de música alternativa en 1996.

quizzes.title: Metallica Trivia: Kings of Thrash Metal
quizzes.description: Eight questions on Metallica: the thrash classics, The Black Album, Cliff Burton and forty years of metal history.

questions.question: In which city was Metallica formed in 1981?
questions.explanation: Lars Ulrich and James Hetfield founded Metallica in Los Angeles in 1981; the band soon moved to San Francisco.

questions.question: Who is Metallica's lead singer and rhythm guitarist?
questions.explanation: James Hetfield has fronted Metallica since its formation.

questions.question: What is the title of Metallica's 1983 debut album?
questions.explanation: Kill 'Em All (1983) opened the thrash metal era.

questions.question: Which 1986 album, featuring the title track 'Master of Puppets', is considered a thrash landmark?
questions.explanation: Master of Puppets (1986) was the last album recorded with bassist Cliff Burton.

questions.question: Which Metallica bassist died in a tour bus accident in Sweden in 1986?
questions.explanation: Cliff Burton died on 27 September 1986 during the Master of Puppets tour.

questions.question: Who has been Metallica's lead guitarist since 1983?
questions.explanation: Kirk Hammett, previously of Exodus, replaced Dave Mustaine in 1983.

questions.question: Which drummer co-founded Metallica after placing a newspaper ad in 1981?
questions.explanation: Ulrich's ad in The Recycler led to his meeting with James Hetfield.

questions.question: Which self-titled 1991 album, known as The Black Album, includes 'Enter Sandman'?
questions.explanation: The Black Album debuted at number one on the Billboard 200 and made Metallica a global headliner.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Metallica: los reyes del thrash metal
quizzes.description: Ocho preguntas sobre Metallica: los clásicos del thrash, The Black Album, Cliff Burton y cuarenta años de historia del metal.

questions.question: ¿En qué ciudad se formó Metallica en 1981?
questions.explanation: Lars Ulrich y James Hetfield fundaron Metallica en Los Ángeles en 1981; poco después la banda se mudó a San Francisco.

questions.question: ¿Quién es el cantante y guitarrista rítmico de Metallica?
questions.explanation: James Hetfield lidera Metallica desde su formación.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se titula el disco debut de Metallica, de 1983?
questions.explanation: Kill 'Em All (1983) abrió la era del thrash metal.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1986, con la canción "Master of Puppets", es un hito del thrash metal?
questions.explanation: Master of Puppets (1986) fue el último disco grabado con el bajista Cliff Burton.

questions.question: ¿Qué bajista de Metallica murió en un accidente de autobús en Suecia en 1986?
questions.explanation: Cliff Burton murió el 27 de septiembre de 1986 durante la gira de Master of Puppets.

questions.question: ¿Quién es el guitarrista principal de Metallica desde 1983?
questions.explanation: Kirk Hammett, antes en Exodus, reemplazó a Dave Mustaine en 1983.

questions.question: ¿Qué baterista cofundó Metallica tras publicar un anuncio en un diario en 1981?
questions.explanation: El anuncio de Ulrich en The Recycler lo llevó a conocer a James Hetfield.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco homónimo de 1991, conocido como The Black Album, incluye "Enter Sandman"?
questions.explanation: The Black Album debutó en el número uno del Billboard 200 y convirtió a Metallica en cabeza de cartel mundial.

quizzes.title: ABBA Trivia: Sweden's Pop Legends
quizzes.description: Eight questions on ABBA: Waterloo, Dancing Queen, the classic albums and the comeback of Sweden's most famous pop group.

questions.question: ABBA won the Eurovision Song Contest in 1974 with which song?
questions.explanation: Waterloo won Eurovision in Brighton in April 1974.

questions.question: The name ABBA comes from the initials of which four members?
questions.explanation: A-B-B-A: Agnetha Fältskog, Björn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson and Anni-Frid Lyngstad.

questions.question: Which country is ABBA from?
questions.explanation: The group formed in Stockholm in 1972.

questions.question: Which 1976 album includes 'Dancing Queen' and 'Money, Money, Money'?
questions.explanation: Arrival (1976) also includes 'Knowing Me, Knowing You'.

questions.question: Which ABBA song was the group's only number-one hit on the US Billboard Hot 100?
questions.explanation: Dancing Queen topped the Hot 100 in April 1977.

questions.question: Which 1999 musical, later made into two films, is built around ABBA songs?
questions.explanation: Mamma Mia! premiered in London in 1999 and inspired two films.

questions.question: Which 1977 album includes 'Take a Chance on Me' and 'The Name of the Game'?
questions.explanation: ABBA: The Album was released alongside ABBA: The Movie in 1977.

questions.question: In which year did ABBA release Voyage, their first studio album in 40 years?
questions.explanation: Voyage came out in November 2021; the avatar concert opened in London in May 2022.

quizzes.title: Trivia de ABBA: las leyendas del pop sueco
quizzes.description: Ocho preguntas sobre ABBA: Waterloo, Dancing Queen, los discos clásicos y el regreso del grupo sueco más famoso.

questions.question: ¿Con qué canción ganó ABBA el Festival de Eurovisión de 1974?
questions.explanation: Waterloo ganó Eurovisión en Brighton en abril de 1974.

questions.question: ¿De las iniciales de qué cuatro integrantes proviene el nombre ABBA?
questions.explanation: A-B-B-A: Agnetha Fältskog, Björn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson y Anni-Frid Lyngstad.

questions.question: ¿De qué país es ABBA?
questions.explanation: El grupo se formó en Estocolmo en 1972.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1976 incluye "Dancing Queen" y "Money, Money, Money"?
questions.explanation: Arrival (1976) también incluye "Knowing Me, Knowing You".

questions.question: ¿Qué canción fue el único número uno de ABBA en el Billboard Hot 100 de Estados Unidos?
questions.explanation: Dancing Queen encabezó el Hot 100 en abril de 1977.

questions.question: ¿Qué musical de 1999, luego llevado al cine, se construyó con canciones de ABBA?
questions.explanation: Mamma Mia! se estrenó en Londres en 1999 e inspiró dos películas.

questions.question: ¿Qué disco de 1977 incluye "Take a Chance on Me" y "The Name of the Game"?
questions.explanation: ABBA: The Album salió junto a ABBA: The Movie en 1977.

questions.question: ¿En qué año lanzó ABBA Voyage, su primer disco de estudio en 40 años?
questions.explanation: Voyage salió en noviembre de 2021; el concierto con avatares abrió en Londres en mayo de 2022.
